_comment: EQ presets, gains in dB per band at 63Hz / 250Hz / 1kHz / 4kHz / 8kHz.
The headphones store only the active curve — the Sennheiser app holds the
preset definitions and pushes them band by band. These were captured off
the wire by watching what the app wrote, so they are the real values, not
estimates. Edit freely; m4ctl reads this file at run time.
verified: seen settle on the wire and confirmed by name.
unverified: captured in sequence but the name is inferred from click order.
